units.source_text: 在释边像前，我们跪下，双手合十，然后走出佛堂。

en.t: In front of the Shakuhen statue, we knelt down, pressed our hands together, and then walked out of the Buddhist hall.

units.source_text: 但是，我们舍不得离开接上，便倚在上来时攀登的台阶旁边朝南的栏杆上。

en.t: But we could not bear to leave that place, so we leaned against the south-facing railing beside the steps we had climbed on the way up.
